title: Run API routes: submit, stop, status, queue
description: The authenticated worker surface behind UC1b, owning src/index.ts routing. POST /api/runs takes project, epic, base_sha, requested_by, notify and an optional queue flag: it validates the token, resolves the project, asks RunRoom for the lease, and either starts a Run Workflow or refuses with the holder run_id (D22). With queue set, a refused submission parks in the DO and ignites on release, visible to status and expiring on a configurable window. POST /api/runs/:id/stop is a clean stop (D15 semantics: finish the in-flight tick, then review and closeout) and must be enforced at the control plane, never as a message the orchestrator has to read. GET /api/runs and /api/runs/:id report Workflow step state plus lease and gate state. Every refusal is written to dispatch_log with its reason code.
acceptance_criteria: A submission on a free project starts a run; on a leased project it refuses naming the holder, and with queue set it parks and later ignites; stop transitions a running run to a clean stop without the orchestrator cooperating; status reports lease, phase and queued submissions; every refusal appears in dispatch_log; all routes reject an absent or wrong bearer token.
